unit.title: One or many?
unit.blurb: Turn one boy into many boys, one book into many books
unit.intro: This drill changes the number. When the subject becomes plural, the verb must follow: _Puer librum legit_ (the boy reads a book) becomes _Puerī librum legunt_ (the boys read a book). When only the object becomes plural, the verb stays as it is: _Puer librōs legit_ (the boy reads books). Remember the plural endings: nominative _-ī_ or _-ae_ or _-ēs_, accusative _-ōs_ or _-ās_ or _-ēs_. Press **Run the drill** when you have met most of them.

roles.s: it is the subject, so it must be nominative
roles.o: it is the object (the thing acted on), so it must be accusative

changes.label: Make the subject plural
changes.explain: A plural subject needs a plural verb: _{s}_ is {s.label}, so the verb is {v.label}: _{v}_. The object _{o}_ stays as it was.

changes.label: Make the object plural
changes.explain: Only the object is plural, so the verb stays singular (_{v}_) and the object becomes {o.label}: _{o}_.

changes.label: Make both plural
changes.explain: Everything is plural: the subject _{s}_ is {s.label}, the verb _{v}_ is {v.label}, and the object _{o}_ is {o.label}.
